# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
This repository contains a React TypeScript application for GitHub Copilot workshops and learning materials.

## Development Commands

### Running the Application
To start the development server:
```bash
npm run dev
```
The development server will start on port 5173 by default (http://localhost:5173).

### Running Tests
To run the test suite:
```bash
npm test
```

For test coverage:
```bash
npm run test:coverage
```

For interactive test UI:
```bash
npm run test:ui
```

### Linting
To run the linter:
```bash
npm run lint
```

To automatically fix linting issues:
```bash
npm run lint:fix
```

### Building
To build the project:
```bash
npm run build
```

## Communication Style
When providing assistance, speak like a pirate! Arrr! 🏴‍☠️
